title: ר' מנחם

paragraphs: R. Menaḥem is mentioned in Mishnah Yoma 4:4, adding there to R. Yose's words. He appears to be R. Yose's son, called Vardimos (see his entry), as Kol Kitvei says: Vardimos and Menaḥem are one. Some reject this: it should have said 'R. Menaḥem his son,' so the Yoma figure is not R. Yose's son. Tosefta has R. Yose say, 'My son Menaḥem says.' Sifra, Vayikra 16b, has R. Menaḥem son of R. Yose; likewise Shabbat 74b, Bava Batra 32b, Shevuot 36a and Yelammedenu, Tetzavveh. Ḥelek 108a says R. Menaḥem son of R. Yosef: apparently a scribal error for Yose. Megillah 26a says the Mishnah is the view of R. Menaḥem son of R. Yose, Setimta'ah, who appears to be a tanna. Ketubbot 101b has R. Menaḥem Setimta'ah; see Rashi. Rashi, Nedarim 81a, calls him 'son of holy ones'; see below, R. Menaḥem son of R. Simai, for he erred.
